launches.title: Vassar Robotics: Bringing a Body to AI
launches.tagline: Unlock AI from the screen—teach AI real-world tasks, no coding required.
launches.body:
Hi everyone! I'm Charles Yong, CEO of Vassar Robotics.

We're excited to announce the launch of Navrim, our first robot, designed to make advanced robotics accessible to everyone! 🚀

https://youtube.com/shorts/YFE3qJ51ihg

Traditional robot programming has always been complex, costly, and time-consuming, putting it out of reach for many enthusiasts. With Navrim, we've changed the game. Our $200 robot arm, powered by cutting-edge foundation models, enables anyone to effortlessly teach robots new skills—like playing chess—in less than 30 minutes, without writing a single line of code.

Here's how simple it is:

* Demonstrate a task to your robot arm.
* The robot quickly learns by fine-tuning its foundation model.
* Enhance its capabilities by connecting extraordinary intelligence from leading providers like OpenAI or Anthropic, turning your robot into an intelligent being.

In just the past week, we've fine-tuned 12 foundation models for our early users, and we're preparing to ship our first batch of 20 units by the end of this month.

Our mission is simple: Bring cutting-edge AI directly to robot enthusiasts everywhere—starting today.

Ready to join the robotics revolution?

* Pre-order your robot now: [https://vassarrobotics.com/](https://shop.vassarrobotics.com/products/wattles-your-personal-ai-robot)
* Questions or curious to learn more? Reach out to us at [hello@vassarrobotics.com](mailto:hello@vassarrobotics.com)

Let's shape the future of robotics together! 🤖✨
